# Élan Summit

> A student summit built around leadership, creative activities and meeting people from other schools.

The first edition took place on 5 and 6 September 2026 at SGIS Pune Campus, Mulshi, Pune. The next edition will feature Crisis Command. Its dates, venue, eligibility and prices have not been announced. Archived 2026 prices and rules must not be presented as current registration details.

## Official pages

- [Élan Summit | Student Leadership & Crisis Command](https://elansummit.com/): Élan Summit brings students together for Crisis Command, creative activities and new connections. Meet the team and explore plans for the next edition.
- [About](https://elansummit.com/about): Learn how Élan Summit began and what students can experience through its cabinet simulation, creative activities and school community.
- [Next Edition & Registration Updates | Élan Summit](https://elansummit.com/next-edition): Follow plans for the next Élan Summit, featuring Crisis Command. Dates, venue, eligibility and registration details will be announced when confirmed.
- [Flagship](https://elansummit.com/flagship): Explore Crisis Command at Élan Summit: cabinet roles, crisis scenarios, team decisions and judging. The page documents the 2026 format.
- [Founder & Co-founders | Élan Summit](https://elansummit.com/founders): Meet Akshit Parmar, founder of Élan Summit, and co-founders Sakshi Baldawa, Prachi Belagali and Jacinth Jebaraj.
- [Contact](https://elansummit.com/contact): Contact the Élan Summit team about school participation, volunteering, partnerships or the first edition. Find the director’s contact details here.
- [2026 Archive | Élan Summit](https://elansummit.com/archive): Explore the Élan Summit 2026 archive: photographs, guests, competitions, programme and original event details from 5 and 6 September in Mulshi, Pune.
- [Élan Summit 2026 in Pictures](https://elansummit.com/first-edition): Revisit Élan Summit 2026 through photographs of the opening ceremony, committee sessions, DJ night, closing ceremony and felicitations.
- [Guests](https://elansummit.com/guests): Meet the guests, judges and school leaders associated with Élan Summit’s first edition in September 2026.
- [Faqs](https://elansummit.com/faqs): Answers to questions about the next Élan Summit, Crisis Command, school participation, volunteering and registration announcements.

Participant and organiser pages require appropriate account access and are not public reference sources.
